growth_stage.evidence:  Kharif  sowing  data  collection  has  started  from  05 th June,  2026  and  the  sowing  is  in  preliminary stage. As on June 05 2026, the area sown under Kharif crops is 72.57 lakh ha (including 54.08 lakh ha in Sugarcane) as compared to 74.61 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
